surface.title: What are you trying to sort today?
surface.body: Pick the nearest job. Folio asks one thing at a time. Nothing changes until review.
surface.plainText: Make it to payday Money now, next income and what must be paid Organise debts Minimum payment, due date and pressure Check bills One bill or must-pay item before income Add bank activity Rows wait in Review before they count Guide me One simple question, then the smallest next step Start Add what you have Review Check rows Today See your picture
